india.one_line: India sees new multilingual AI model, policy draft, and industry growth, while Poland seeks AI partnership.

themes.title: Chariot releases multilingual speech model
themes.text: Chariot launched Chariot‑1‑ASR Realtime, a speech‑to‑text model supporting ten Indian languages and reporting lower error rates across 79 public test sets.

stories.headline: Chariot launches real‑time speech model for 10 Indian languages

themes.title: India prepares AI law consultation
themes.text: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced the government will draft a consultation paper on AI legislation in the coming weeks, inviting input from society, citizens and industry.

stories.headline: India to issue AI law consultation paper in coming weeks, says minister

themes.title: Poland seeks AI partnership with India
themes.text: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk called for stronger technology partnerships with India, proposing joint AI development, digital product creation and space technology projects and inviting Indian firms to joint ventures at the Global Investors Meet 2027.

stories.headline: Polish prime minister calls for deeper AI, digital and space cooperation with India

themes.title: Indian firms expand AI capabilities
themes.text: LTM opened the BlueVerse Industrial AI Lab in Chennai for clients, partners and its teams to develop, simulate and validate AI solutions for industrial operations. Infosys reported AI revenue grew 29% quarter‑on‑quarter, representing 10.5% of total revenue, while lowering its FY27 growth outlook to 1‑2%.

stories.headline: LTM launches BlueVerse Industrial AI Lab in Chennai
Infosys AI revenue rises 29% QoQ as FY27 growth guidance cut to 1-2%
